column2: g_0 = +g with all other couplings zero: energy per particle of uniform matter (state of lowest energy with respect to the polarization; no-sea approximation) at six total densities. In the covariant form particles of different halves then attract each other
column4: and the coupling T_V = G_Vc = -g/16 of the square of the total density is negative: the energy per particle falls without bound as the density grows (the contact model has no state of lowest energy; it needs a cutoff). In the quantized-sector form the scalar coupling repels and the energy per particle rises
